items.text: We're serving a new patch, here is everything you can find in the new 1.4 (Autumn) Update! ^^
(Read until the end for a little sneak peek!)
You're now able to select a previous Chapter once you passed it, as well asdiscover which Voice of Magic you are! ^^
You'll have access to the Chapter Selection once you've passed a dedicated Chapter.
And Magic Quiz will appear after Chapter 1!
You will likely launch the game with "Continue"
Depending on your progression, you'll be able to only access the Chapters you will unlock following this update:
○ You're in Chapter 2, and will progress to Chapter 3.
○ Only Chapter 3 would be available, unfortunately Chapter 1 and 2 would not.
○ This is because we can't track back the choices player made in their playthrough regarding relationships and choices, therefore it is not retroactive.
But it's possible to have it working from the very beginning by launching a "New Game"!
It'll directly appear on your Main Menu.
A Little Tease for Completionists

For those of you who have already completed the main story and are eager to continue Lunne's adventure - we are hard at work on something special for you! We can officially confirm that an Endless Mode is on the way! ✨🧁
Romance and Friendship paths with Estelle are now fixed!
We fixed typos across various languages.
Lunne's mother should not call too early before the interview anymore.
Restaurant time with Estelle should give energy again.
Lunne should not be turning her back at Kei anymore when having big talks.
We removed butter from Millefeuille boiling step!
Lys' quest should be triggering correctly again.
Lunne should not reach burnout state anymore before or at 10/04.
Twinkles are moving again when being recruted for the first time.

notes.title: Don't worry - updates on consoles are coming as well! Here is the current status

items.text: Xbox & PS5: Currently in line with version 1.3 from Steam. We are expecting the 1.4 update to go live for these platforms hopefully by the end of this week! ^^

Nintendo Switch & Nintendo Switch 2: Please rest assured that we are hard at work bringing the updates to you <3 The approval process on Nintendo platforms takes a bit longer than on other consoles, which is causing the delay. We are very sorry for the wait and inconvenience! We hope the 1.3 update will be approved and ready within a week, with 1.4 following by the end of next week.

As you all know, we are currently hard at work on fixing bugs and following up on community feedback. Thank you, for taking the time to share your thoughts & feedbackwith us, we appreciate it so very much and are actively working through patches :)
There is also a little more sweet content on the menu in the months ahead! Here is a sneak peek at what's baking on our roadmap:
Our ovens are running as we whisk up fresh patches & more coming. We couldn’t ask for a sweeter community, your help and support has been incredible <3
We will see you soon again with more updates!

items.text: Bonjour bakers!! 💖
We just got a fresh patch straight out the oven. 🤩
Here is everything you should know about the ingredients behind patch 1.3:
Ghaldari's door is available again on June 18th! The door was invisible in a specific case that was preventing to do his quest.
We fixed some colliders in the Sadness Heart Palace that could create locks in a dialog in a specific context.
We have fixed the situation where the restaurant in Bassin de la Villette was locked after the red twinkle entered it.
We fixed a specific context where a scene would not play in the bakery during chapter 5, and create an inconsistency with Judith.
We fixed an issue where the third option of a dialog choice would not be clickable with the mouse.
We fixed an issue where players could get locked during Heart dives when reaching 0 energy.
Best's Quest should be fixed as well in the case where you first didn't show interest in his work.
We added a popup screen at launch to inform player if they try to play on the Demo Save.
Rooftop talk with Orio is not playing every night anymore.
Some Orio's dialogue were sometimes playing twice, and shouldn't anymore.
We fixed some typo that were present in the French cinematic.
We fixed some visual glitches in the Fear Heart Palace.
We displayed the figures differently in the Skill Tree screen, so that it appears all on the same line.

notes.title: EDIT 28/10: We also fixed Estelle and Lunne's dialogue when following the Friendship route during the main story.

items.text: One optional dialog has been reported to still have an issue in the friendship route, it will get fixed in the next patch!
Thank you all so much for your support and feedback!! We are working on squashing even more bugs and adding some new features soon, keep an eye for more posts! 😉
Happy baking!~

Hello Bakers!
A freshly baked patch just dropped! Here's what we've cooked up/fixed up:
Jogging is now a toggle instead of a hold button!
When going to the park with Daniel, the energy regained will no longer be lower than it should be. (It was 150 instead of 200!)
Mawuli's first heart will no longer be blocked between May 7 and May 13.
Mawuli will no longer be briefly sitting in mid-air when you visit his appartment during his first heart. (But it was a cool magic trick!)
We've updated an Anger Heart Dive (the bakery puzzles) to offer another possible path!
The phone's audio was looping on a dialog during Chapter 3.
Updated Lunne's character models in a tense scenes: she was smiling instead of being concerned. (come on, Lunne...)
It's no longer possible to access the customisation shop during tense moments of the story. We love decorating, but maybe not at the time haha!
We fixed a few typos in English, French and Chinese - thank you for letting us know
We're currently testing the fix of Estelle's relationship blocker which we talked about in this post.
We should be able to release a hotfix tomorrow latest, thank you for your support and patience <3

notes.title: 💘 EDIT: 3pm French time, the fix for Estelle's relationship is now live! 💘

items.text: We wanted to thank you all for the bug reports - please rest assured we are working on getting them ironed out! There will be another patch coming this week ^^
EDIT Oct 23: We have moved the patch to early next week to get more testing time as there are a lot of fixes!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967950/The_Witchs_Bakery/"]
[p align="justify"]We have an important update regarding our launch. We have made the decision to move the release date of The Witch's Bakery from 20 August to 14 October 2026.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/479afad206412b8b3c8a0365b75f788a1da7cb02.png"]
We’re very sorry for this new delay, it really wasn’t an easy decision!😥

We know you all have been incredibly patient and supportive throughout the development already! And for that, first of all, we would like to thank all of you. The reasons behind this are a mix of getting more polish time and the (quite) daunting September month that’s already packed with games.😅

A month away from August 20, we are still finding a few bugs here and there that make us think that we need just a liiiitle bit more time. Problem is, September is very crowded, with big games coming out, and events… and though we have 100% faith in our little witch’s appeal, we would rather not risk a competition with much bigger titles than us.
[p align="justify"]We only got one shot at releasing The Witch’s Bakery, and we want to give you the best version we can possibly make!

[p align="justify"]We are so very grateful for your patience, your passionate feedback, and your support as we put the finishing touches on Lunne’s adventure. October 14 will be here before you know it, and we can’t wait to get the game in your hands!
Our physical versions for Nintendo Switch, Switch 2 and PlayStation5 will be available from Friday October 16.
[p align="justify"]And as always, stay magical~~✨
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967950/The_Witchs_Bakery/"]

releases.displayName: The Witch's Bakery Japanese Support - Update

items.text: Hello again to our Japanese-speaking bakers,
Thank you so much for your patience! We’ve processed your feedback and Japanese language support is now officially back in the demo!
We’re so grateful for your help in improving The Witch's Bakery. Enjoy the demo in Japanese and let us know what you think.
As always, stay magical! ✨
Hello to our Japanese-speaking bakers, and thank you for playing The Witch's Bakery demo!

We're sincerely grateful for the feedback you’ve shared regarding the Japanese support in the current demo build. We are actioning this immediately, we have temporarily removed the Japanese language option and are working to resolve the issues you've highlighted. Once this is resolved we will re-introduce Japanese support and update you here.

Thank you so much for all the kind words you've shared while playing the demo. We’ve been watching a lot of your streams, videos and posts, and we can’t express how happy we are with the overwhelmingly positive feedback!
Before we get back into development for the full release of The Witch's Bakery, we want to iron out a few things in the demo to ensure your experience stays as smooth as possible.

Thank-You Screen - We heard you! Several streamers noticed there wasn’t a thank-you message at the end of the game, a big miss on our part, so sorry for that! We’ve now added a proper thank-you screen right after the quiz. It’s our way of showing gratitude to everyone who plays and supports the game.

Localized Content - Activities, Relationship Quests, and Books are now integrated in most languages! Previously, some of this content was only available in English due to production constraints. Now, players can enjoy the game in their own language. There may still be a few English bits here and there, but we’ll keep improving the overall localization!
Book Reading Limit - Books can now only be read once, preventing repeated skipping of dialogue that broke the narrative flow. This small fix keeps the story experience consistent for all players.
Bakery UI Improvements - We’ve repositioned the helper UI in the Bakery to make inputs clearer.
Decoration Helpers - Minor adjustments to helpers in the Decoration section to improve readability. We will continue to work on the decoration to make the experience smoother.
From the bottom of your hearts, thank you so much for your support!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967950/The_Witchs_Bakery/"]And of course, stay magical ✨
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/4c6c998d0ccdff2579a10fdb782ead225672aa44.png"]
We hope you're doing well on this early December! Don't forget a cup of hot chocolate or tea to stay warm! ☕
Let's dive into the update!
Development 🖥️
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/63fada9c6cc57a866c713170cd2d492c0b692c92.png"]
We're happy to share that we've reached Chapter 4, which revolves around the emotion Anger.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/b3dcc3ec2dc832061293ed968ed0da163c96534c.png"]
In this chapter, you'll meet Kei Takeuchi, a former French-Japanese Michelin-starred chef, and learn more about his story and the Regret he carries.
Art 🎨
We did some research about a new character that appears in the Chapter 3, Mille-Lieux! She's a reporter who often visits The Aside. She plays a very important role in our universe.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/9c1fe9d5fe7d3a0fe676c9878f9c81306da8cfa6.png"]
She also happens to be Mawuli's mother! Aren't they adorable together? 🥺💕
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/a4ed7d65c9d9741f41bc9fb7fa984afa2577d335.png"]
We upload daily content about the development on our Discord, if you haven't joined it yet, click here!
Thank you for your presence and support everyday, it melt our hearts and we can't wait to see what's next! 💕
Here's the monthly news of The Witch's Bakery! We hope you had a fantastic Halloween night with plenty of spooky treats! 🍬
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/5821ad01fc535af88a35302c02021cdc6e54366d.png"]

If you didn't saw our last news, we're so happy to tell you that The Witch's Bakery is coming to all platforms: Xbox Series X/S, Playstation 5 and Switch 1! It's all thank to your amazing support day by day that we are able to expand our magic in many platforms! 🎮
Speaking about the game, we did our very first playtest! It went very well and we're happy to see all your reactions. There's a lot to adjust and evolve but so many great things came out!

We’re working closely on the Heart Palace Fear, creating new assets and balancing it to make it as impressive as the Heart Palace Sadness! We really want each Heart Palace to be impressive and convey the emotion of its chapter.
And we also have new animations for fear, look at her with sadness! Which one's the cutest?👀
We upload daily content about the development on our Discord, click here to join it!
Until then, stay magical✨

It’s already October, the best month of the year! Time to bring out your pumpkins and witch hats, hehe 🎃🧙‍♀️
A lot has been happening at the studio lately, so here’s a little recap:

Originally, The Witch's Bakery was supposed to release in October 2025, but as you may have seen in our previous updates, we’ve decided with our publisher to shift the release to 2026. This extra time will allow us to put even more effort into the Heart Palace and to give you the best story possible. We’re more motivated than ever and can’t wait to share this adventure with you! 🥰
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/5fe7948b02a84c9e1aef889b27bdd85cc52104ba.png"]

Of course, we’ll keep sharing plenty of updates across our social networks. We’re beyond happy to see your reactions to our universe and creation and it gives us so much motivation, Thank you so, so much! 💖
60k Witchlists!

Speaking of support, we’ve reached 60,000 wishlists on Steam! We’re incredibly grateful and it still amazes us that our love for Lunne and her story resonates with you. Again, we can't thank enough for all the amount of love.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/20ab98f137cb46da61c97b93741b854fddadd20d.png"]

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967950/The_Witchs_Bakery/"]
The days are getting shorter, the sun is slowly putting itself to rest… We hope you all had a wonderful summer! Here are the latest The Witch’s Bakery updates!
It’s already been 1 year since the Kickstarter was launched, and we never expected to receive so much love and support.

A huge thank you for being here with us every day, and for the affection you show towards our characters, our art, and our universe. Without you, The Witch’s Bakery wouldn’t exist. We’re working hard to bring you the very best game possible. We’ll keep spreading magic all around us, and with you. Thank you so much again for being part of this adventure! 💕

We’ve reworked an important mechanic in the game. In the bakery, you’ll encounter regrets that accompany customers. Regrets are spectral creatures of many forms! Invisible to humans, they mostly feed on the surplus of human emotions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/71f3e77d20fdd720656daf6cff4bed6707aa05f4.png"]

At first, the mechanic was a quick timed event mechanic to synchronize with the person’s heart. But now, it has completely changed: when you use your Heart Dive, a labyrinth appears, representing the client’s inner emotional conflict. Lunne must then guide the emotion to the exit to release it.
We’ve also worked on customer behaviour to make your days in the bakery more varied. Impatient clients, hesitant ones, big orders… Now you’ve had a true taste of Parisian sass 🤭
And more illustrations! 🖼️

We’ve started adding illustrations to spice up our dialogues! Below, a panel of Mirembe and Ghaldari during their very first meeting! Look at these cuties. And this is just the beginning, I can’t wait for you to meet them all! ✨
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/8a70f58dc8d6172990fdea21531f7bbfb0509061.png"]
And until the next news.. stay magical✨ [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967950/The_Witchs_Bakery/"]
We're already halfway through 2025, time flies! 😯
Before we dive into the news, we’d like to wish you all a joyful Pride Month. 🏳️‍🌈

Love can takes so many shapes and colors and we hope to move forward together, united in love and joy, and continue to share meaningful values as Sunny Lab, speaking spark of hope and happiness for everyone. ❤️
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/672d84fdb3b84154fdf139c32ff62ad362b9b934.png"]
Let’s go for the news!

We’re excited to announce that we’re currently working on Estelle’s Heart Palace, which has changed a lot since the last time we shared it with you. We’ve added waterfalls, coral structures… and the puzzles have also been redesigned! 🎨
\[VIDEO HP]
On another topic, several new character model dialogues have been added to the game!
We mentioned Raphael in our last update, he now has two new character dialogues model!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/b7438c7979dad92b47ac79ab4dfeac7d2eb0a942.jpg"]
But he’s not the only one! Mawuli is also starting to get his own character dialogues model. We’re looking forward to fully integrating him into the game and more are on their way too! ✨
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018826/ae7033ef30fd386bf89ee37144780a59a353575a.jpg"]
Lastly, Mirembe now has a broom animation, making her even cooler than she already is. 😎
We upload daily content about the development on our Discord, if you haven't joined it yet, click here!
And if you are a backer, you can access exclusive updates about what we're baking at the moment! Just follow the instructions on the #ticket-backers channel if you haven't claimed your access!
See you for the next update~!
Until then, stay magical!✨
